Everything else clean: 250k-body fuzz (all JSON types, odd casing/zero-width/NFKC, nested ref keys, AuthorisationRequired 1/yes/True!/true/True) found 0 violations of I1/I2/I3 (never raises, max 0.7 ms/body, 300k-node/depth bodies degrade to unknown); real failure texts (Insufficient funds, Invalid beneficiary, Daily limit exceeded, Beneficiary not found) are 'failed' at data and entry level (I4 ok); execute() simulation: success->executed, auth true->needs_authorisation, auth True!/1/yes->needs_review, ref+error / success-sounding error / empty / mixed -> needs_review (reserved, 1 POST total, re-instruction parked possible_duplicate), real failure -> failed (released). Currency gate: every ISO code except ZAR caught upper-case in 28 formats incl. split by space/newline/zero-width/dash/dot/full-width; legit instructions pass; TRY/ALL/TOP/BOB payees park (fail-safe); 200KB hostile <= 0.05 s. Sanitizer/scrub linear (<= 0.05 s on 200KB incl. eyJ*70000, _*200000). Mailbox: real UTF-7 of INBOX is &AEkATgBCAE8AWA- (the '&AEkATgBCAE8AFg-' in the brief decodes to 'INBO'+U+0016, a different name, correctly allowed); all INBOX spellings, wildcards, backslash, folding, UTF-7 refused, sub-labels allowed, refused before any fetch. blockers.severity: medium-high (money-moved 200 released; a duplicate still needs a fresh human approval; real Investec 200 shape unverified until G2)
blockers.issue: 'failed' (reservation released, not duplicate-guarded) is returned for ANY non-placeholder string ErrorMessage that lacks the narrow success-word list and has no 'ref'-named key. So a 200 body with ErrorMessage-only text that means 'money moved / outcome indeterminate' is released: 'Succeeded', 'Payment made', 'Payment already made', 'Funds transferred', 'Transfer sent', 'Sent', 'Transferred', 'Payment submitted', 'Created', 'Queued', 'Processing', 'Pending', 'Pending approval', 'Payment requires authorisation in Investec Online', 'Awaiting second signatory', 'Duplicate payment detected', 'Gateway timeout', 'Service unavailable', 'Internal server error', 'Unknown error', 'Error: none', 'Errors: 0', 'No problems', 'All good', 'okay'. Same for success-shaped bodies whose id field is not named *ref* (TransactionId, paymentId, confirmationNumber, receipt, id) or is split ('r e f'). Reservation released => identical instruction after the hold reaches awaiting_approval and, once re-approved, can pay twice.
blockers.fix: Invert to an allow-list: 'failed' only when the ErrorMessage matches a known definite-rejection pattern (insufficient funds, invalid/unknown/not found beneficiary, limit exceeded, account blocked/closed/inactive, declined, rejected, invalid account/amount) AND contains none of the success/pending/indeterminate/duplicate/timeout/authoris/approval words; everything else with an error but no reference -> unknown (needs_review). Also treat keys containing id/receipt/confirm/transaction as reference-like. Or (simplest until G2) release only on 4xx PaymentRejected. Add parametrised tests for the texts above.
blockers.repro: from invespend.payments.outcome import parse_payment_response as P; for t in ['Payment made','Pending','Gateway timeout','Duplicate payment detected','Succeeded','Error: none']: print(P({'data':{'ErrorMessage':t}}).status)  # all 'failed'. Via Env(live=True) with responder returning {'data':{'ErrorMessage':'Pending approval'}}: row status 'failed', daily_reserved False, re-instruct => awaiting_approval (scratchpad/f4/e.py).

nits.issue: Deny-list gap for lower/Title-case ISO codes and names after a LABELLED bare number: 'Amount: 100 sek', 'Amount: 100 nok', 'Amount: 100 Sek', 'Amount: 100 kr', 'Rs', 'lei', 'Kc', 'zl', 'Brazilian real', 'Korean won', 'Swiss francs', 'renminbi', 'bucks' are not foreign and parse as ZAR 100.00 (as do 'R100 sek', 'R100 brl'). Only upper-case codes, glued lower-case (100sek) and listed words are caught. Blast radius: owner-authored text, and the approval email shows 'ZAR 100.00' to the human.
nits.fix: After a labelled/unmarked number, treat any alphabetic word that is not a ZAR word (rand/zar/r/rands/cents-free list) as foreign (allow-list), or add lower-case ISO codes directly after a digit/label separated by <=2 spaces (excluding collision words all/top/try/bob/lek/som/dong).
nits.repro: marked_amount_candidates('Amount: 100 sek') == ['100.00'] and has_foreign_currency_token('Amount: 100 sek') is False

nits.issue: scrub_message (error envelope) lacks the long-token, address and space-grouped-digit rules that sanitize_provider_message has: 'AIzaSyA-<35 chars>', base64 blobs, 'ya29.' tokens, bare 40-char hex (only its digit runs are cut), 'bob@example.com', '5169 1234 5678 9012' pass through. Known prefixes, JWT, AKIA, keyword-adjacent values, configured secrets are redacted.
nits.fix: Also apply _TOKEN (24+ chars) and _ADDRESS/_DIGITS from outcome.sanitize_provider_message.

nits.issue: Mailbox names with a NUL or other non-whitespace C0 control after INBOX ('INBOX\x00') are not treated as the shared inbox (strip() does not remove them). A server that truncates at NUL could select INBOX; imaplib/most servers reject such names. Unicode dot-leaders and NBSP/soft-hyphen variants are (safely) refused.
nits.fix: Refuse any mailbox name containing a Cc character other than after stripping, or drop all Cc/Cf chars in _normalised_mailbox.

nits.issue: Symbol-only ErrorMessage or reference text (e.g. '<U+226A>') folds to blank and is ignored; an entry-level reference plus a symbol-only error is 'success'. A >5000-char punctuation-only entry reference is 'success' (never stored: only ok/live is recorded). Both are fail-safe in direction (success is duplicate-guarded).

Classifier can return 'failed' (I4 satisfied), so it is not over-conservative; the opposite problem is RS3AF4-1. Script FAILs 'B daily 3x20000', 'C renamed', 'E loop reply', 'E loop banner' re-confirmed as script-expectation issues identical to fix3 baseline, no behavioural regression.
